name: Machine ab crunch
instructions: Set the seat so the pads or handles sit at your upper chest.
Sit with your feet hooked under the foot pads.
Curl your chest down toward your hips by tightening your abs.
Rise back up slowly without letting the weight rest.
cue: Curl down with the abs, not the arms
mistakes: Pulling with the arms instead of the abs.
Bouncing the weight at the bottom.
